techniques.name: Self-Ask decomposition
techniques.goal: Reduce compositional errors by turning multi-hop problem into explicit subquestions
techniques.mechanism: Model decides whether follow-up questions are needed, asks/answers them sequentially, then composes final answer; subquestions can be delegated to search/tools.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS version should route subquestions to authoritative retrieval rather than self-answer when freshness matters.
avoid_when: Modern reasoning model already decomposes reliably

techniques.name: Step-Back Prompting
techniques.goal: Prevent local details from obscuring governing principle
techniques.mechanism: Ask for relevant high-level concept/first principle before solving concrete problem, then condition solution on that abstraction.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential constructive-challenge tactic: first restate underlying outcome/principle, then assess proposed solution.

techniques.name: Chain-of-Verification
techniques.goal: Reduce factual hallucinations by separating draft and verification
techniques.mechanism: Draft response, generate targeted fact-check questions, answer checks independently, then revise based on verification.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Prefer external-source verification; use CoVe to generate what needs checking.
use_when: Long-form claims where external evidence unavailable
avoid_when: Web/files/tool evidence is available and more authoritative

techniques.name: Independent verification-question answering
techniques.goal: Reduce anchoring of fact checks on the draft answer
techniques.mechanism: Answer each generated verification question without showing the original draft/other verification answers, then reconcile.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS can route verification questions to independent source/tool/model packets.
avoid_when: Verification depends on broader answer context

techniques.name: Generated Knowledge Prompting
techniques.goal: Surface latent relevant knowledge before answering
techniques.mechanism: Generate multiple relevant facts/knowledge statements, then condition answer generation/selection on them.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Treat generated knowledge as hypothesis, never source/provenance evidence.
risks: Generated premises can hallucinate and poison answer

techniques.name: Knowledge-generation ensemble
techniques.goal: Reduce dependence on one generated premise
techniques.mechanism: Sample multiple knowledge statements/answer paths and select/aggregate predictions.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: If external evidence exists, spend the compute retrieving/verifying instead.

techniques.name: Analogical Prompting / self-generated exemplars
techniques.goal: Create task-tailored demonstrations without curated examples
techniques.mechanism: Ask model to recall/generate analogous solved problems/lessons before solving target.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Verifier should check analogy/result; retrieve real past Agent OS examples when available.
avoid_when: Generated examples may introduce false domain facts

techniques.name: Retrieve-real-analogy before self-generating one
techniques.goal: Use actual prior successes/failures instead of invented exemplars when the system has them
techniques.mechanism: Search historical task/eval/skill corpus for similar solved cases; only self-generate analogy if no strong real match.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Combines analogical reasoning with provenance-preserving episodic memory.
risks: Surface similarity can retrieve misleading case

techniques.name: Self-Discover reasoning structure
techniques.goal: Choose task-specific reasoning scaffold instead of one universal CoT recipe
techniques.mechanism: Select from atomic reasoning modules and compose a structure suited to the task, then solve using it.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Meta Engine can test discovered scaffolds offline and promote reusable structures as skills only if holdout gains persist.
use_when: Repeated task class lacks known best scaffold
avoid_when: Modern reasoning model works better with minimal direct prompt

techniques.name: Reusable discovered reasoning template
techniques.goal: Amortize expensive scaffold discovery across repeated task family
techniques.mechanism: Once a discovered structure passes evals across cases/models, save it as versioned task skill and skip rediscovery each call.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Exactly the kind of success pattern Skill Miner should identify.
avoid_when: Template becomes stale across model upgrades

techniques.name: Emotional-stimulus prompt suffix
techniques.goal: Potentially nudge performance/style through affective language
techniques.mechanism: Append emotional/social stakes language such as importance/encouragement before task response.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Catalog it so future models know it was tried; do not bake theatrical urgency into Agent OS prompts.
use_when: Prompt-behavior research only unless local A/B proves robust gain
risks: may stop working after model update

techniques.name: Politeness-level tuning
techniques.goal: Test whether tone materially affects a model/language task
techniques.mechanism: Vary rude/neutral/polite language while holding semantics constant and measure task behavior.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS should choose tone for human communication quality, not rely on it for model intelligence.

techniques.name: Prompt-threat/tip/reward wording
techniques.goal: Explore folklore that simulated rewards/threats change effort/output
techniques.mechanism: Add fictitious tip, stakes, reward or threat language and A/B against neutral instruction.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Preserve as folklore/experiment class; neutral direct prompts remain default.

techniques.name: Prompt repetition / emphasis
techniques.goal: Increase salience of a critical constraint by repeating/reformatting it
techniques.mechanism: Repeat or emphasize one rule in multiple locations or capitalization/format when model reliably misses it.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Try deterministic guard first; use repetition only after a targeted failure/eval.
use_when: A specific constraint repeatedly fails and deterministic enforcement is impossible
avoid_when: Constraint can be enforced in code/schema

techniques.name: Instruction sandwiching around long context
techniques.goal: Keep task requirements salient when evidence block is long
techniques.mechanism: Place concise objective/critical constraint before and optionally after large context body.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Test against a single end-position action summary already used by Agent OS.
use_when: Long-context models with measured positional sensitivity
avoid_when: Stable-prefix caching where repeated suffix duplicates tokens without benefit

techniques.name: Critical-information edge placement
techniques.goal: Mitigate measured lost-in-the-middle behavior
techniques.mechanism: Place most critical task instruction/evidence at positions empirically favored by the target model while leaving less critical context in middle.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Capability registry should hold layout sensitivity; don't hard-code universal 'best position'.
use_when: Long contexts with proven position sensitivity
risks: Optimizing one model's quirks harms portability

techniques.name: Claim-first verification plan
techniques.goal: Turn a long answer into explicit checkable factual units before final synthesis
techniques.mechanism: Extract/materialize claims, classify which need external support, independently verify them, then generate prose from verified claim set.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Fits proposed CLM/FND registries and evidence-first writing.
risks: Claim extractor can miss implied claims

techniques.name: Answer-after-evidence ordering
techniques.goal: Reduce conclusion anchoring during research
techniques.mechanism: Retrieve/assess evidence and alternatives before writing final conclusion instead of drafting verdict then searching for support.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Draft hypotheses separately; do not treat early prose as target answer.
avoid_when: Need initial hypothesis only as explicitly labeled search seed

techniques.name: Disconfirming-evidence prompt
techniques.goal: Actively search for reasons a favored hypothesis could be wrong
techniques.mechanism: Ask for strongest counterevidence, failure cases, boundary conditions and competing explanations before promotion.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only for material hypotheses; evidence must be sourced, not invented objections.

techniques.name: Uncertainty-triggered scaffold escalation
techniques.goal: Use explicit reasoning scaffold only when simple direct prompt underperforms or validator detects ambiguity
techniques.mechanism: Start direct; escalate to decomposition/step-back/self-ask/verification based on task family and failure signal.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Treat prompt technique itself as a routed capability, not a global system prompt.
risks: Bad uncertainty signal either overthinks or underthinks

techniques.name: Prompt-hack quarantine
techniques.goal: Keep unexplained benchmark tricks from becoming permanent architecture
techniques.mechanism: Techniques with unclear mechanism/model dependence live in experimental catalog; promotion requires multi-model/task holdout and periodic re-test.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Separates 'someone tried this' from 'Agent OS should do this'.
risks: May delay a cheap useful trick
